notice.title: Before you start
notice.what_is_sent: Sent: this lesson's details, ratings, class notes, your report draft, the last 3 reports and anything you add.
notice.deidentified: Names, schools, phone numbers, emails and ID numbers are replaced with codes before sending and restored afterwards.
notice.providers: Content is processed by the AI service your administrator configured (or your own account).
notice.logged: Each generation's de-identified content, model and the parts you use are recorded.
notice.responsibility: AI drafts are suggestions; check them before sending to parents.

errors.AI_DISABLED: The AI report assistant is turned off.
errors.AI_NOTICE_REQUIRED: Please read and acknowledge the usage notice first.
errors.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The selected model is no longer available; choose another source.
errors.AI_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: The site quota is used up.
errors.AI_SECRET_KEY_MISSING: Credential encryption is not configured on the server; this source is unavailable.
errors.AI_CREDENTIAL_INVALID: This source's credential is invalid; choose another source or update the credential.
errors.AI_DEIDENTIFICATION_UNAVAILABLE: De-identification is unavailable, so nothing was sent to protect personal data.
errors.AI_DEIDENTIFICATION_INCOMPLETE: Some personal data could not be removed, so nothing was sent.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI service returned an error. Try again later or use another source.
errors.AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT: The AI took too long to respond. Try again later.
errors.AI_GENERATION_CANCELLED: Generation stopped; no quota was used.
errors.AI_STREAM_INTERRUPTED: The connection was interrupted. Please retry.
errors.AI_SAVE_REQUIRED: The report has not been saved yet. Save it, then generate.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to use AI on this report.
errors.NETWORK_OFFLINE: You are offline. Reconnect and try again.
errors.AI_UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
